name: Evil Flight Strike
evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 2026-09-26 Batch 454 current-evidence enrichment: 100-Ki Strike Super / 300-Stamina Evasive variant. The CaC version is restricted to Namekians and Majins and rises slowly while flailing with extended arms for eight hits; current dedicated evidence reports 15% total damage and keeps the target airborne for follow-ups. Piccolo (Power Awakening) repurposes the technique as an Evasive. The source explicitly warns that a miss leaves the user exposed; exact active/recovery frames and scaling remain unresolved.
evidence_boundaries: Unsupported exact frames, scaling formulas, probabilities, hidden conditions, and patch-independent balance values were not inferred.
Source-reported numerical values remain bounded evidence.
